_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11400 — with preserveModules, `[name]` must keep extensions that are not JS/TS, matching Rollup. `card.json` is emitted as `card.json.js` so it does not take `card.js` away from the real module (which would be renamed `card2.js`). `note.ts` still drops `.ts` and stays `note.js`.
